last_response.character_name: Side-scroller game hero, full body, a slender young elf wanderer, standing at ease. Shoulder-length violet-purple hair, long pointed elf ears, calm pale face, his head bare and his hair fully visible. He wears a fitted dark green high-collared tunic with thin gold trim down the front, a brown leather belt, dark brown trousers and tall brown leather boots with turned-down cuffs. A long ankle-length forest-green cloak hangs behind him from the shoulders; its hood is down, folded flat on his upper back below the collar, never over the head. Empty hands at his sides. Clean single color dark outline, top-left light.
